Configuration File (Fields and Lists)
No file linked

Shared file (e.g. in your SharePoint folder) with the Field Configuration and dropdown Lists. Link the same file from every computer on the team — any change saved here shows up for everyone the next time they open the app or switch tabs. While it's linked, this configuration stops being read/written in the data Excel.

Supplementary Data (Map)
No file linked

Read-only Excel with extra layers for the Map tab (e.g. water wells and high-voltage lines, each sheet with a "geojson" column). Not editable from the system — it's reference information only, drawn on the map.

Consolidated — all markets (read-only)
Inactive

Connect the root folder that contains one subfolder per office (e.g. "Market Information") to see records from every market at once across Properties, Parks, Land, and Transactions — you can still filter by Market/Submarket like you already do. While it's active, the system is read-only (nothing can be created, edited, or deleted) and your individual Excel gets unlinked: the two are mutually exclusive, only one at a time.

Location IDs (Region/State/Market/Submarket)

Buildings, Parks, Land, Offices, and Transactions each carry a hidden Region/State/Market/Submarket ID (matched against the CATALOGO_UBICACION catalog) for relating data in the BI — names alone aren't unique. New records get theirs automatically when the Region/State/Market/Submarket fields are selected. Use this button once to fill them in on records that already existed before this — it never changes Last Modified.

Update Location catalog (one-time migration)

If you renamed Markets/Submarkets and reassigned their IDs in a new copy of LISTAS_CAMPOS.xlsx (keeping the old ID_REGION/ID_STATE/ID_MERCADO/ID_SUBMERCADO columns as reference), use this once to carry those renames over to Properties/Parks/Land/Offices/Transactions already captured — matched by the old ID, not by name, so renamed markets are found correctly. It then leaves that file linked as your Configuration file, same as linking it directly. Doesn't affect Last Modified.
